intro.text: A refugee mother in Luthadel who has lost all but her youngest child since the Collapse.

items.text: Three of her children died in koloss attacks and two more on the flight to Luthadel. While she and her sick baby sheltered with other refugees in a warehouse, Sazed offered advice on caring for the child; he tried to comfort her, but saw that talk of a long-lost religion would not ease her grief.
